newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Tessenderlo splits share, in buy-back, staff issue.
newsitem.headline: Tessenderlo splits share, in buy-back, staff issue.

text.p: Belgian chemicals group Tessenderlo Chemie said on Tuesday that shareholders had agreed a 10-for-1 share split and authorised the board to buy back shares and issue new stock to staff.

Board chairman Gerard Marchand told shareholders the split and the buy-back should have an positive effect on the share price. The split, reducing the value of the share to the 1983 level of about 1,700 francs, would make it easier for new shareholders to buy stock.
The share was down 125 francs at 17,800 francs on a broadly weaker Brussels bourse.

The buy-back option should increase shareholder value. The company is issuing a maximum 150,000 new shares to staff at 1,390 francs per share to increase staff involvement in the group, Marchand said.
